roles.mission: שער hash לפני קומיט בליין dex — אסור לדחוף תוכן ישן כקומיט חדש
roles.law: חוק האמת: מה שמוצג חייב להיות נמדד (G-law)

roles.mission: שער טריות: receipts ירוקים חייבים להוכיח שהמקור הפנימי טרי (R1 ממפת הערך)
roles.value: fail-soft לא יסתיר עוד מקור קפוא

roles.openedBy: an unverified contract id and an ignored sort parameter made a healthy rail look dead; ops signed blind are mined but never applied (Z-29 lesson, corrected in Z-30 by the research team)
roles.contract: validate every rail before any signature: contract id copied character-for-character from an APPLIED third-party op, settlement read from sidechain state, never from a mined trx alone

roles.openedBy: idle inventory and dust either rot or get noise-sold; the economy needs every routable unit working
roles.contract: two-sided engine desk: harvest inventory above keep-reserves at live bids, route proceeds into maker orders, hold dust honestly

roles.openedBy: broadcast-only presence reads as a press agency, not a community; networks reward dialogue
roles.contract: daily self-audience pass: read, reply and curate across steem/hive/blurt in per-account voices (support the public, never expose the fleet)

roles.openedBy: ten accounts posting identical skeletons reads as spam and kills reach (operator msg 26: duplications and errors in content)
roles.contract: per-account renderers, alternating formats, chain-native summaries, zero verbatim twins across chains

roles.openedBy: several money books were written by different agents and disagreed; a sovereign unit needs one ledger per truth
roles.contract: single-writer rule per book topic; cross-book reconciliation daily; contradictions tombstoned, not argued

roles.openedBy: 30+ workflows spawned by bootstrap commits, twins across Console/Domain burning public-Actions minutes and muddying authorship
roles.contract: one canonical home per duty; dispatch-only tombstones on the duplicates; the repo reads as one body, not layers
roles.mechanismEvidence: agents/workflow-audit.cjs twin scan + reviewable prune plan

roles.openedBy: the operator found pages broken on mobile; every public page must hold at 390px with a menu that actually closes
roles.contract: browser-verify every public page at 390x844 after each UI wave; menus close on route/tap; tables scroll; no horizontal bleed
roles.mechanismEvidence: none yet — role stands open until a mechanism exists (honest board)
